rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account via the tool, which satisfies identity requirements. It looked up the order and product variants using read-only tools before acting. The agent identified the order as delivered and followed the proper exchange path, presented available replacement options and availability, calculated and disclosed the price difference and payment method to be charged, and sought explicit confirmation before submitting the exchange. After receiving “yes,” it executed the exchange via the appropriate tool using the user’s gift card and then confirmed the request and next steps. While some tool outputs were truncated (so we cannot independently re-verify the ceramic variant price and availability statements), nothing contradicts the tool data, and the flow adheres to policy. No unauthorized disclosures or unsupported fabrications are evident, and no writes occurred without confirmation.
